item.title: James Douglas
item.description: In sadness, we say goodbye to our beloved Dad, Grandpa, and Great Grandpa, Jimmy. He passed away at Innisfail Hospital on January 31, 2026. Jimmy was preceded in death by his parents, William and Lily Douglas, his siblings Bay, Lily, Nancy, and Smiley, his cherished wife of 64 years, Mary, and his grandson, Douglas. He is survived by his children RoseMarie, Beth, Jimmy, and Billy, along with a large and loving extended family.
